payload.summary: All thirteen historical/current Foundation managed conflicts received semantic dispositions; Devkit 0.1.2 was merged; Foundation reached 16 EXACT / 0 MISSING / 0 CONFLICT and the reconciliation candidate was merged unchanged.

Foundation was formally adopted into Devkit 0.1.2. Adoption added only .qiven ownership metadata, immediate sync left both ownership-state files byte-identical, and the validated candidate tree was merged no-ff to main.

payload.summary: Chat-mode validation instructions should use git diff --check / git diff --cached --check, status, and exact SHA checks rather than raw git diff output. Exact diff review belongs to jason-brother; raw Git diff may invoke a pager and appear to hang in Windows CMD.

Adoption check/apply is operationally correct, but its human-facing plan and result output should eventually receive test-runner-grade layout, counts, status emphasis, and final safety messaging without blocking current adoption semantics.
